decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's established modular recycling know-how and already shows a quantified customer saving, so a growing R&D-active firm is likely to retain and refine it rather than withdraw it.

The shredder is close to the core product base and therefore well within the firm's absorptive capacity, but the lack of visible outcome evidence and possible overlap with newer shredder launches make portfolio rationalization somewhat more plausible.
This concept has very strong relatedness to existing capabilities and by 2024 had both a named customer case and quantified savings evidence, which supports continued commercialization and learning.

As a 2024 slow-speed shredder launch it fits closely with the firm's installed knowledge, service network and development capabilities, so management would usually give it more time to scale and improve.

The mobile spiral shaft screens extend the existing screening and material-processing competence base, and the firm's own R&D and research links increase the chance of successful adaptation rather than quick withdrawal.
